title: Updating the $K$ register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $4$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its $K$ value by $y$.
replaced:
Let a register record have its 15 natural-number coordinates stored in order as a
vector, with coordinate 4 equal to its $K$ field. Replacing coordinate 4 of this vector
by a natural number $y$ gives the vector of the record obtained by replacing its $K$
field by $y$.
